cleansingStrength.rationale: The sulfate-free system has enough breadth for effective ordinary cleansing, but isethionate/sarcosinate anionics are buffered by two betaines and a light polymer rather than reading as a strong reset chassis.
formulaFacts: SODIUM COCOYL ISETHIONATE is an anionic isethionate at position 2.
LAURAMIDOPROPYL BETAINE and COCAMIDOPROPYL BETAINE are amphoteric betaines at positions 3 and 4.
SODIUM LAUROYL SARCOSINATE is an anionic sarcosinate at position 5.
POLYQUATERNIUM-10 at position 11 is a conditioning counter-signal.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Two anionic cleansing routes plus TETRASODIUM EDTA position 13 provide more reset breadth than a low-cleansing mild shampoo.

conditioningLevel.rationale: One meaningful cationic polymer route should provide some manageability support, but the late humectant/plant-juice clues and absence of silicone or rich lipid systems keep the level bounded.
formulaFacts: POLYQUATERNIUM-10 appears at position 11 as the only conditioning/deposition route.
GLYCERIN position 24 and COCOS NUCIFERA FRUIT JUICE position 25 are late light care clues.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: The polymer is after fragrance/preservative ingredients and is not reinforced by silicone, fatty alcohol or meaningful lipid routes.

weightPotential.rationale: Noticeable cumulative weight is unlikely because deposition is limited to one later cationic polymer and late light humectant/plant clues, while the cleansing system has broad reset capacity.
formulaFacts: POLYQUATERNIUM-10 position 11 is the only substantive conditioning polymer route.
GLYCERIN position 24 and COCOS NUCIFERA FRUIT JUICE position 25 are late light care clues.
SODIUM COCOYL ISETHIONATE position 2 and SODIUM LAUROYL SARCOSINATE position 5, buffered by betaines at positions 3 and 4, provide effective cleansing/reset.
TETRASODIUM EDTA at position 13 adds chelating support but is not counted as deposition.
weightPotential.counterSignal: Polyquaternium-10 can be persistent and could leave some residue on repeated use.

structuredWeightAssessment.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate because there is no silicone, rich lipid, waxy payload or interacting deposition system beyond polyquaternium-10.
